2609.27669.title: The Path Matters: Evaluating Small Language Models Beyond Answer Accuracy in KGQA
2609.27669.paper_summary: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly paired with knowledge graphs (KGs), yet end-to-end KG question answering conflates graph access, search, navigation, reasoning, and answer generation. This coupling makes it difficult both to determine whether an SLM can faithfully execute the reasoning path implied by a question and to attribute failures to navigation rather than to other stages of the pipeline. We isolate this capability by employing the THESEUS navigation and traceability framework and using frozen, off-the-shelf SLMs as local action policies. At each hop, the environment exposes the legal outgoing graph actions, and the model selects one executable graph action and decides whether to stop, without task-specific parameter updates, model-controlled beam search, or free-form answer generation. This controlled setting allows us to evaluate terminal-answer accuracy with Hits@1 together with path fidelity, using Path Edit Distance (PED) as the primary trajectory metric. Across the Kinship and MQuAKE-ST KGQAs, similarly sized local models differ substantially in answer accuracy and path fidelity, with the two metrics sometimes favoring different models. This model-dependent behavior also extends to prompting, as a single demonstrated trajectory can improve or degrade navigation depending on the model. These results motivate evaluating SLM graph reasoning beyond endpoint accuracy alone.
2609.27669.paper_summary_zh: 小型語言模型（SLMs）越來越多地與知識圖譜（KGs）配對，但端到端的KG問題回答將圖譜訪問、搜索、導航、推理和答案生成混為一談。這種結合使得既難以確定SLM是否能忠實執行問題所暗示的推理路徑，也難以將失敗歸因於導航而非管道的其他階段。我們通過採用THESEUS導航和可追溯性框架，並使用冷凍的現成SLM作為局部行動策略來孤立這一能力。在每一步中，環境會顯示合法的外發圖譜行動，模型選擇一個可執行的圖譜行動並決定是否停止，而無需特定任務的參數更新、模型控制的束搜索或自由形式的答案生成。這種受控的環境使我們能夠使用Hits@1評估終端答案的準確性以及路徑的忠實度，並以路徑編輯距離（PED）作為主要的軌跡指標。在Kinship和MQuAKE-ST KGQA中，大小相似的局部模型在答案準確性和路徑忠實度上存在顯著差異，這兩個指標有時會偏向不同的模型。這種依賴模型的行為也擴展到提示，因為單一的示範軌跡可以根據模型改善或降低導航效果。這些結果促使我們在評估SLM圖譜推理時，不僅僅關注端點準確性。
